name: Parallel API
description: Parallel Web Systems API — web search and research built for agents. POST /v1/search takes an objective plus keyword queries and returns ranked pages with compressed markdown excerpts (modes: turbo, fast, basic, advanced). POST /v1beta/extract returns full or targeted page content for a list of URLs. The Task API (POST /v1/tasks/runs, then GET /v1/tasks/runs/{run_id} and /result) runs async research tasks that return structured JSON with citations. Auth is handled automatically via the PARALLEL_API_KEY environment variable, injected as the x-api-key header. Beta endpoints additionally need a per-request parallel-beta header — see the Parallel note in CONNECTIONS.md.

testConnection.description: Runs a minimal turbo-mode search to verify the Parallel API key
